corpus_name: SCN Phase 3 ReData and land-protection policy corpus
generated_for: Sovereign Compute Nexus Phase 3 bounded policy classifier
research_note: This is the curated working corpus used to frame ReData as a data-center incentive problem constrained by Brazilian environmental, indigenous, protected-land, and consultation law. Journal entries were identified from publisher/DOI pages because the scite MCP was unavailable due to account usage limits.
